subject: refactor(ssh_dotnet): narrow fatal-path Connect catches to ArgumentException (S2221)
body:
refactor(ssh_dotnet): narrow fatal-path Connect catches to ArgumentException (S2221)

Narrow the authentication-build and client-create catches from Exception to
ArgumentException (the realistic type). Safe because both are on the fatal path:
anything unexpected bubbles to Connect()'s top-level catch, which performs identical
error handling. Non-fatal handlers and background I/O-loop catches are deliberately
left broad -- narrowing them would turn recoverable errors fatal / crash the I/O tasks.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: SonarCloud catch-narrowing in SSH_DotNet files absent from our fork; nothing to apply.
